topic: U17 native-crash static analysis (cc-t3, reassigned from cc-wiki)
shared_root_cause: bionic<->musl sysconf _SC_* numbering mismatch: NDK apps call sysconf(bionic#); OH musl reads the same int as a different selector. Page-size queries are fatal.

fennec.root_cause: mozjemalloc init reads gPageSize via sysconf(0x27); musl 0x27=_SC_BC_STRING_MAX=1000 (not power of two) -> MOZ_RELEASE_ASSERT(1<<gPageSize2Pow==gPageSize) fails -> MOZ_CRASH. putenv/strdup is only the first lazy-init malloc.
fennec.corrected: the earlier putenv+44->strdup+48 'bad pointer' theory is wrong: strdup arg is a null-checked GetStringUTFChars result
fennec.fix: sysconf remap in libbionic_compat (39/40->30, 96/97->83/84, full range)

im_vector_realm.fault: SIGSEGV(SEGV_MAPERR)@0 — ldr w8,[x27,x23,lsl#2] @0x7738e0 with x27=m_translations(obj+0x30)=NULL, in nativeGetSharedRealm
im_vector_realm.root_cause: Realm SlabAlloc sizes/attaches .realm mmap sections from sysconf(0x27)/sysconf(0x28) page size; under musl those are wrong -> translation table never populated (NULL) -> first ref->address translation derefs NULL.
im_vector_realm.certainty: strong; last step (garbage-page-size -> NULL table) inferred (static disasm can't show the attach decision)
im_vector_realm.not_a_mutex_abi_crash: the guarding pthread_mutex_lock SUCCEEDED (cbnz not taken @0x65d23c); no setrobust/setpshared imports
im_vector_realm.probe_needed: only if fix-and-rerun inconclusive (minimal read-only interposer; see evidence/probe-design.txt)

fix.what: sysconf() wrapper translating bionic _SC_* -> musl before delegating to musl sysconf
fix.kind: libc compat shim (not a stub, not don't-fix)
fix.scope: app-native callers; runtime code already uses musl numbering
